sentences.text: Respondent no.2 though served in the matter has remained unrepresented.
3. On the basis of the complaint lodged by respondent no.2 dated 09.08.2023, FIR in Crime No.270/2023 was registered for the offence under Section 363 IPC against unknown persons.
In the complaint, it is averred that complainant's NC: 2023:KHC:40956 minor daughter aged about 16 years was found missing from the house from 07.08.2023 onwards.
Efforts made by the complainant to trace the missing girl was in vain.
Therefore, he has approached the police and lodged the complaint.
4. During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner and the victim girl were traced on 15.08.2023.
Subsequently, the petitioner was produced before the jurisdictional court and remanded to judicial custody on 16.08.2023.
The victim girl was subjected to medical examination on 16.08.2023 and her statement under Section 164 Cr.PC was recorded by the jurisdictional Magistrate on 19.08.2023.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner's bail application filed before the Trial Court in Crl. Misc. No.8380/2023 was rejected on 08.09.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Counsel for the petitioner has reiterated the grounds urged in the petition and has prayed to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
The material available on record would go to show that the petitioner and the victim girl are in love.

The victim girl had voluntarily accompanied the petitioner and traveled along with him to Gandlavaripalli village in Andhra Pradesh State and had stayed there in the house of petitioner's relative till 15.08.2023.
The victim girl has not made any allegation against the petitioner about sexually assaulting her against her wishes.

Even in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.PC befor the jurisdictional Magistrate, she has stated that she was in love with the petitioner and after her parents came to know about the same, she was scolded by her parents.
A reading of her statement would go to show that she had voluntarily accompanied the petitioner and had stayed in his relative's house till 15.08.2023.
The charge sheet allegations made against the petitioner is required to proved in a full-fledged trial.
Petitioner is aged about 21 years.
Undisputedly, he has no other criminal antecedents and he is in custody from 16.08.2023.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioner has made out a case for grant of regular bail.

Accordingly, the following order:
NC: 2023:KHC:40956 8.
The petition is allowed.
